result.topic_en: The page finishes a remark that the branch points of an algebraic curve f(x,y)=0 correspond to points where ∂f/∂z=0, then sets the task of treating the different representations of a ternary definite form as a quotient of sums of squares by continuously varying the coefficients, with the case where φ=ψ=χ=0 share a common point being the critical one.

items.quote:
Bemerkt sei, dass die Brennpunkte
der algebraischen Curve $f(x,y)=0$ den Verzwei-
gungspunkten entsprechen, [-weil-] da dieselben
durch $\frac{\partial f}{\partial z}=0$ bestimmt sind.
items.english: Let it be remarked that the foci of the algebraic curve f(x,y)=0 correspond to the branch points, since these are determined by ∂f/∂z=0.

items.quote:
Behandle auch die verschiednen Darstellungen
der ternären definiten Form als Quotient von
Quadratsummen, je nachdem die 3 im Zähler
auftretenden Formen $\varphi, \psi, \chi=0$ gesetzt Curven
darstellen deren Züge sich schneiden & in einan
der liegen, etc.
items.english: Also treat the various representations of the ternary definite form as a quotient of sums of squares, according to whether the 3 forms φ, ψ, χ appearing in the numerator, when set equal to 0, represent curves whose branches intersect or lie inside one another, etc.

items.quote:
Führe die Untersuchung durch
continuirliche Veränderung der Coefficienten,
wobei der Fall, dass $\varphi=0$, $\psi=0$, $\chi=0$ durch
einen und denselben Punkt gehen, der
kritische ist.
items.english: Carry out the investigation by continuous variation of the coefficients, where the case in which φ=0, ψ=0, χ=0 pass through one and the same point is the critical one.
